name: Daiwa Securities Group Inc.
summary: Daiwa Securities Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the financial and capital markets in Japan, Europe, Asia, Oceania, and the United States. It operates through Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Markets & Investment Banking segments. The Wealth Management segment offers financial products and services for individual and unlisted corporate customers; and stocks, bonds, investment trusts, and insurance products. The Asset Management segment provides securities, real estate, and alternative asset management services.
